Find the second [[Elementalist]] trainer.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Elementalist
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Search for [[Kai Ying]] in [[Panjiang Peninsula]].

===Reward===
* 600 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Kai Ying can be found just south of [[Kaitan Village]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Ronsu
''You have done well, young one. It is time for you to move on to the next stage of your education. From here you should seek out [[Kai Ying]] in [[Panjiang Peninsula]]. He is a good teacher, but beware his sharp tongue or you'll quickly find yourself the target of his jokes.''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will look for Kai Ying.
| decline = I'm not much for humor, actually.
| ask = Look for [[Kai Ying]] in [[Panjiang Peninsula]].
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Kai Ying
''You made it! I have heard that you are quite the "Ether Prodigy." I am Kai Ying. I heard you might be coming, [Character Name], and I am "Lightning Touched" that you wish to train with me. When I heard the good news I felt a "Searing Heat" inside. You are going to learn so much!''

==Trivia==
*The reward dialogue is a series of puns on the elementalist skills [[Ether Prodigy]], [[Lightning Touch]], and [[Searing Heat]].
